ns2:course.label: Chinese Popular Lit
ns2:course.description: Surveys Chinese popular literary works written in the vernacular language (short story, novel, and drama), with attention to cultural and artistic values. Same as CWL 308. No knowledge of Chinese is required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as CWL 308. No knowledge of Chinese is required.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Lit & Arts, and Cultural Studies - Non-West course.
